blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: ___ (мировой) экономика впала в рецессию.
exercises.prompt: The global economy has fallen into a recession.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «экономика»: nominative singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: A giant lizard is destroying the city!
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «ящер»: nominative singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «партия»: nominative singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
